title: Weather information for an aviation job
description: The reports and units you need, gathered into one consistent view.

blocks.text: In a professional summary, even a mismatch of units between the app and the widget gets in the way of the reading someone is used to. That is a narrow consistency problem, and it is worth separating from a promise to plan a flight in full.

quote.text: This application is incredibly useful. As a pilot, weather plays a crucial role in flight planning. Windy provides valuable insights that ensure the safety of passengers. In my search for the best weather app, this one emerged as the clear winner.

blocks.text: Choose a specific set of reports together with a specialist and test it on the main screen and in the widget: units, issue time, missing data. Start from one consistent view, not from a universal aviation assistant.
Find out which sources and tools the user still has to open alongside. If the new screen only duplicates them and adds one more cross-check, there may be no separate product here.
